```{r}
# read GTF
gtf <- fread(
  "../../../DO_Striatum_RNAseq/Initial_test_rpvg_results/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.114.chr.gtf",
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  fill = TRUE,
  comment.char = "#"
)

colnames(gtf) <- c(
  "chr", "source", "feature", "start", "end",
  "score", "strand", "frame", "attributes"
)

# keep only transcript rows
gtf_tx <- gtf[feature == "transcript"]

# extract transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name
gtf_tx[, transcript_id := sub('.*transcript_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', attributes)]
gtf_tx[, gene_id       := sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', attributes)]
gtf_tx[, gene_name     := sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', attributes)]

# keep one row per transcript
tx2gene <- unique(
  gtf_tx[, .(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name)]
)

# strip transcript/gene version suffixes just in case
tx2gene[, transcript_id_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", transcript_id)]
tx2gene[, gene_id_noversion       := sub("\\..*$", "", gene_id)]

# read ASE table
fread("JJ_high_prob_filtered_simplified.tsv") -> JJ_high_prob_filtered

# read significant ASE results
fread("DESeq2_ASE_significant_lfc1.txt") -> sig_res_df
sig_tx <- unique(sig_res_df$Transcript_cluster)

# restrict ASE table to significant transcripts only
JJ_high_prob_filtered <- JJ_high_prob_filtered[
  Transcript_cluster %in% sig_tx
]

# ASE transcript list
ase_dt <- as.data.table(JJ_high_prob_filtered)

ase_tx <- unique(
  ase_dt[, .(Transcript_cluster)]
)

# strip version from ASE transcript IDs just in case
ase_tx[, Transcript_cluster_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", Transcript_cluster)]

# map transcript -> gene
ase_gene_map <- merge(
  ase_tx,
  tx2gene,
  by.x = "Transcript_cluster_noversion",
  by.y = "transcript_id_noversion",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# prepare Svenson gene annotation
annot_mrna <- as.data.table(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$annot.mrna)
annot_mrna[, gene_id_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", gene.id)]

# join ASE transcripts to Svenson gene annotation
ase_eqtl_annot <- merge(
  ase_gene_map,
  annot_mrna,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# keep only transcripts that mapped to a gene in the Svenson object
ase_eqtl_annot_matched <- ase_eqtl_annot[!is.na(gene.id)]

# keep one row per gene for gene-level annotation fields
gene_annot_unique <- unique(
  ase_eqtl_annot_matched[, .(
    gene_id_noversion,
    gene.id,
    symbol,
    chr,
    start,
    end,
    strand,
    middle,
    nearest.marker.id
  )]
)

# additive peak table
lod_add <- as.data.table(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$lod.peaks$additive)
lod_add[, gene_id_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", gene.id)]
lod_add[, marker_pos_bp := as.numeric(tstrsplit(marker.id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[2]])]
lod_add[, marker_pos_mb := marker_pos_bp / 1e6]

lod_add_gene <- merge(
  gene_annot_unique[, .(gene_id_noversion, middle)],
  lod_add,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all = FALSE
)

setorder(lod_add_gene, gene_id_noversion, -lod)

lod_add_gene_summary <- lod_add_gene[, .(
  additive_peak_marker.id = marker.id[1],
  additive_peak_lod = lod[1],
  additive_peak_distance_mb = abs(marker_pos_mb[1] - middle[1]),
  additive_n_peaks = .N
), by = gene_id_noversion]

# diet interaction peak table
lod_diet <- as.data.table(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$lod.peaks$diet_int)
lod_diet[, gene_id_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", gene.id)]
lod_diet[, marker_pos_bp := as.numeric(tstrsplit(marker.id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[2]])]
lod_diet[, marker_pos_mb := marker_pos_bp / 1e6]

lod_diet_gene <- merge(
  gene_annot_unique[, .(gene_id_noversion, middle)],
  lod_diet,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all = FALSE
)

setorder(lod_diet_gene, gene_id_noversion, -lod)

lod_diet_gene_summary <- lod_diet_gene[, .(
  diet_int_peak_marker.id = marker.id[1],
  diet_int_peak_lod = lod[1],
  diet_int_peak_distance_mb = abs(marker_pos_mb[1] - middle[1]),
  diet_int_n_peaks = .N
), by = gene_id_noversion]

# sex interaction peak table
lod_sex <- as.data.table(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$lod.peaks$sex_int)
lod_sex[, gene_id_noversion := sub("\\..*$", "", gene.id)]
lod_sex[, marker_pos_bp := as.numeric(tstrsplit(marker.id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[2]])]
lod_sex[, marker_pos_mb := marker_pos_bp / 1e6]

lod_sex_gene <- merge(
  gene_annot_unique[, .(gene_id_noversion, middle)],
  lod_sex,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all = FALSE
)

setorder(lod_sex_gene, gene_id_noversion, -lod)

lod_sex_gene_summary <- lod_sex_gene[, .(
  sex_int_peak_marker.id = marker.id[1],
  sex_int_peak_lod = lod[1],
  sex_int_peak_distance_mb = abs(marker_pos_mb[1] - middle[1]),
  sex_int_n_peaks = .N
), by = gene_id_noversion]

# merge gene-level summaries back onto transcript-level table
ase_eqtl_summary <- merge(
  ase_eqtl_annot_matched,
  lod_add_gene_summary,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all.x = TRUE
)

ase_eqtl_summary <- merge(
  ase_eqtl_summary,
  lod_diet_gene_summary,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all.x = TRUE
)

ase_eqtl_summary <- merge(
  ase_eqtl_summary,
  lod_sex_gene_summary,
  by = "gene_id_noversion",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# keep one row per transcript
ase_eqtl_summary <- unique(
  ase_eqtl_summary[, .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    transcript_id,
    gene_id,
    gene_name,
    symbol,
    chr,
    start,
    end,
    strand,
    middle,
    nearest.marker.id,
    additive_peak_marker.id,
    additive_peak_lod,
    additive_peak_distance_mb,
    additive_n_peaks,
    diet_int_peak_marker.id,
    diet_int_peak_lod,
    diet_int_peak_distance_mb,
    diet_int_n_peaks,
    sex_int_peak_marker.id,
    sex_int_peak_lod,
    sex_int_peak_distance_mb,
    sex_int_n_peaks
  )]
)

setorder(ase_eqtl_summary, Transcript_cluster)

# diagnostics
ase_mapping_summary <- data.table(
  metric = c(
    "ASE transcripts",
    "Mapped to GTF transcript",
    "Mapped to Svenson gene annotation",
    "Genes with additive peak",
    "Genes with diet interaction peak",
    "Genes with sex interaction peak"
  ),
  count = c(
    nrow(ase_tx),
    sum(!is.na(ase_gene_map$gene_id)),
    nrow(ase_eqtl_annot_matched),
    sum(!is.na(ase_eqtl_summary$additive_peak_lod)),
    sum(!is.na(ase_eqtl_summary$diet_int_peak_lod)),
    sum(!is.na(ase_eqtl_summary$sex_int_peak_lod))
  )
)

ase_mapping_summary[, fraction := count / nrow(ase_tx)]

ase_mapping_summary
head(ase_eqtl_summary)
```

```{r}
library(qtl2)
fread("Founders-pantranscriptome-info.tsv") -> Founders_info

# choose one transcript to test
transcript_to_test <- "ENSMUST00000059091"

subset(sig_res_df, Transcript_cluster == transcript_to_test)
subset(Founders_info, Transcripts == transcript_to_test)

# pull the transcript/gene summary row
test_row <- ase_eqtl_summary[Transcript_cluster == transcript_to_test][1]

if (nrow(test_row) == 0) {
  stop("transcript_to_test was not found in ase_eqtl_summary")
}

chr_use <- as.character(test_row$chr)
marker_use <- test_row$nearest.marker.id
gene_use <- test_row$gene_id

# expression vector for this gene
pheno_use <- Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$data$norm[, gene_use]

# subset to mice shared between expression, genoprobs, and kinship
common_ids <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    names(pheno_use),
    dimnames(genoprobs[[chr_use]])[[1]],
    rownames(K[[chr_use]])
  )
)

pheno_use <- pheno_use[common_ids]
addcovar_use <- as.matrix(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$covar.matrix[common_ids, , drop = FALSE])
kinship_use <- K[[chr_use]][common_ids, common_ids, drop = FALSE]

# keep genoprobs as a one-chromosome calc_genoprob object
genoprobs_use <- genoprobs[common_ids, chr_use]

# calculate founder coefficients across the chromosome
coef_chr <- scan1coef(
  genoprobs = genoprobs_use,
  pheno = pheno_use,
  kinship = kinship_use,
  addcovar = addcovar_use
)

# inspect available positions
head(rownames(coef_chr))

# extract coefficients at the nearest marker
if (!(marker_use %in% rownames(coef_chr))) {
  stop(paste("Nearest marker", marker_use, "not found in coef_chr rownames"))
}

coef_at_marker <- data.table(
  founder = colnames(coef_chr),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coef_chr[marker_use, ])
)

coef_at_marker <- coef_at_marker[order(-coefficient)]

test_row
coef_at_marker
```

```{r}
# coefficients for all ASE transcripts at the nearest marker only
# using rz so the coefficients match the browser

library(qtl2)
library(data.table)

coef_targets <- unique(
  ase_eqtl_summary[!is.na(gene_id) & !is.na(chr) & !is.na(nearest.marker.id), .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    gene_id,
    chr = as.character(chr),
    marker = nearest.marker.id
  )]
)

# cache shared objects by chromosome so they are not rebuilt every iteration
chr_levels <- sort(unique(coef_targets$chr))
chr_cache <- vector("list", length(chr_levels))
names(chr_cache) <- chr_levels

for (chr_i in chr_levels) {
  common_ids <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    list(
      rownames(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$data$rz),
      dimnames(genoprobs[[chr_i]])[[1]],
      rownames(K[[chr_i]])
    )
  )

  chr_cache[[chr_i]] <- list(
    common_ids = common_ids,
    addcovar_use = as.matrix(Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$covar.matrix[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]),
    kinship_use = K[[chr_i]][common_ids, common_ids, drop = FALSE],
    genoprobs_use = genoprobs[common_ids, chr_i]
  )
}

coef_list <- vector("list", nrow(coef_targets))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(coef_targets))) {
  transcript_use <- coef_targets$Transcript_cluster[i]
  gene_use <- coef_targets$gene_id[i]
  chr_use <- coef_targets$chr[i]
  marker_use <- coef_targets$marker[i]

  common_ids <- chr_cache[[chr_use]]$common_ids
  addcovar_use <- chr_cache[[chr_use]]$addcovar_use
  kinship_use <- chr_cache[[chr_use]]$kinship_use
  genoprobs_use <- chr_cache[[chr_use]]$genoprobs_use

  pheno_use <- Svenson_DO_HFD_mrna$data$rz[common_ids, gene_use]

  # pull genotype probabilities for exactly one marker
  genoprob_at_marker <- pull_genoprobpos(
    genoprobs = genoprobs_use,
    marker = marker_use
  )

  fit_out <- fit1(
    genoprobs = genoprob_at_marker,
    pheno = pheno_use,
    kinship = kinship_use,
    addcovar = addcovar_use
  )

  coef_dt <- data.table(
    Transcript_cluster = transcript_use,
    gene_id = gene_use,
    chr = chr_use,
    marker = marker_use,
    marker_bp = as.numeric(sub("^[^_]+_", "", marker_use)),
    term = names(fit_out$coef),
    coefficient = as.numeric(fit_out$coef),
    fit_lod = unname(fit_out$lod)
  )

  coef_dt <- coef_dt[term %in% c("intercept","A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H")]

  intercept_value <- coef_dt[term == "intercept", coefficient][1]
  coef_dt[, intercept := intercept_value]
  coef_dt[, predicted_value := ifelse(term == "intercept", intercept, intercept + coefficient)]

  coef_list[[i]] <- coef_dt

  if (i %% 500 == 0) {
    cat("Processed", i, "of", nrow(coef_targets), "transcripts\n")
  }
}

coef_all <- rbindlist(coef_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

head(coef_all)
```

```{r}
# join transcript-specific haplotype identities to founder coefficients
# keep only rows that are valid and resolvable for coefficient comparison

library(data.table)

peak_window_mb <- 1
ase_ratio_pseudocount <- 0.5

pair_string <- function(a, b) {
  if (is.na(a) || is.na(b)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(sort(c(a, b)), collapse = "/")
}

parse_founder_set <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(character(0))
  unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, "/", fixed = TRUE))))
}

make_valid_pairs <- function(parent1_codes, parent2_codes) {
  parent1_codes <- sort(unique(parent1_codes[!is.na(parent1_codes)]))
  parent2_codes <- sort(unique(parent2_codes[!is.na(parent2_codes)]))

  if (length(parent1_codes) == 0 || length(parent2_codes) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  pairs <- expand.grid(parent1_codes, parent2_codes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  unique(mapply(pair_string, pairs[[1]], pairs[[2]]))
}

resolve_oriented_assignment <- function(founder_1_candidates_str,
                                        founder_2_candidates_str,
                                        parent1_founders,
                                        parent2_founders) {
  cand1 <- parse_founder_set(founder_1_candidates_str)
  cand2 <- parse_founder_set(founder_2_candidates_str)
  p1 <- parse_founder_set(parent1_founders)
  p2 <- parse_founder_set(parent2_founders)

  valid_pairs <- make_valid_pairs(p1, p2)

  if (length(cand1) == 0 || length(cand2) == 0 || length(valid_pairs) == 0) {
    return(list(
      founder_1_code = NA_character_,
      founder_2_code = NA_character_,
      n_oriented_assignments = 0L,
      oriented_assignments = NA_character_,
      coef_comparable = FALSE
    ))
  }

  oriented <- CJ(founder_1_code = cand1, founder_2_code = cand2, unique = TRUE)
  oriented[, unordered_pair := mapply(pair_string, founder_1_code, founder_2_code)]
  oriented <- oriented[unordered_pair %in% valid_pairs]

  if (nrow(oriented) == 0) {
    return(list(
      founder_1_code = NA_character_,
      founder_2_code = NA_character_,
      n_oriented_assignments = 0L,
      oriented_assignments = NA_character_,
      coef_comparable = FALSE
    ))
  }

  oriented_assignments <- paste(
    paste(oriented$founder_1_code, oriented$founder_2_code, sep = "/"),
    collapse = ";"
  )

  if (nrow(oriented) == 1) {
    return(list(
      founder_1_code = oriented$founder_1_code[1],
      founder_2_code = oriented$founder_2_code[1],
      n_oriented_assignments = 1L,
      oriented_assignments = oriented_assignments,
      coef_comparable = TRUE
    ))
  }

  return(list(
    founder_1_code = NA_character_,
    founder_2_code = NA_character_,
    n_oriented_assignments = nrow(oriented),
    oriented_assignments = oriented_assignments,
    coef_comparable = FALSE
  ))
}

# keep only founder rows from coef_all and standardize founder names
qtl2_founder_key <- data.table(
  founder_code = c("A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H"),
  founder_strain = c(
    "A/J",
    "C57BL/6J",
    "129S1/SvImJ",
    "NOD/ShiLtJ",
    "NZO/HlLtJ",
    "CAST/EiJ",
    "PWK/PhJ",
    "WSB/EiJ"
  )
)

coef_all_std <- merge(
  coef_all[
    term %in% c("A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H"),
    .(Transcript_cluster, gene_id, chr, marker, marker_bp, fit_lod, founder_code = term, coefficient)
  ],
  qtl2_founder_key,
  by = "founder_code",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# read permissive parental mosaic validation table from previous ELN step
mosaic_check_dt <- fread("Significant_ASE_vs_parental_mosaic_check_permissiveHST.txt")

# keep only significant transcripts already defined upstream and only valid HST-pair rows
mosaic_check_dt <- mosaic_check_dt[
  Transcript_cluster %in% sig_tx &
  Sample %in% c("JJ013", "JJ014") &
  hst_pair_valid == TRUE
]

# resolve actual founder assignments for coefficient comparison
resolved_list <- vector("list", nrow(mosaic_check_dt))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(mosaic_check_dt))) {
  resolved <- resolve_oriented_assignment(
    founder_1_candidates_str = mosaic_check_dt$founder_1_candidates_str[i],
    founder_2_candidates_str = mosaic_check_dt$founder_2_candidates_str[i],
    parent1_founders = mosaic_check_dt$parent1_founders[i],
    parent2_founders = mosaic_check_dt$parent2_founders[i]
  )

  resolved_list[[i]] <- data.table(
    Transcript_cluster = mosaic_check_dt$Transcript_cluster[i],
    Sample = mosaic_check_dt$Sample[i],
    founder_1_code = resolved$founder_1_code,
    founder_2_code = resolved$founder_2_code,
    n_oriented_assignments = resolved$n_oriented_assignments,
    oriented_assignments = resolved$oriented_assignments,
    coef_comparable = resolved$coef_comparable
  )
}

resolved_dt <- rbindlist(resolved_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# ASE rows
ase_rows <- fread("JJ_high_prob_filtered_simplified.tsv")
ase_rows <- ase_rows[
  Transcript_cluster %in% sig_tx &
  Sample %in% c("JJ013", "JJ014")
]

# attach permissive HST validation fields
ase_rows <- merge(
  ase_rows,
  mosaic_check_dt[, .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    Sample,
    founder_1_candidates_str,
    founder_2_candidates_str,
    founder_1_n_candidates,
    founder_2_n_candidates,
    parent1_founders,
    parent2_founders,
    valid_f1_pairs,
    hst_pair_valid
  )],
  by = c("Transcript_cluster", "Sample"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# attach resolved founder assignments for coefficient comparison
ase_rows <- merge(
  ase_rows,
  resolved_dt,
  by = c("Transcript_cluster", "Sample"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# keep only rows valid for coefficient comparison
ase_rows <- ase_rows[coef_comparable == TRUE]

# attach coefficient for founder 1
ase_rows <- merge(
  ase_rows,
  coef_all_std[, .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    gene_id,
    chr,
    marker,
    marker_bp,
    fit_lod,
    founder_1_code = founder_code,
    coef_1 = coefficient
  )],
  by = c("Transcript_cluster", "founder_1_code"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# attach coefficient for founder 2
ase_rows <- merge(
  ase_rows,
  coef_all_std[, .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    founder_2_code = founder_code,
    coef_2 = coefficient
  )],
  by = c("Transcript_cluster", "founder_2_code"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# add additive peak information from ase_eqtl_summary
ase_rows <- merge(
  ase_rows,
  ase_eqtl_summary[, .(
    Transcript_cluster,
    nearest.marker.id,
    additive_peak_marker.id,
    additive_peak_lod,
    additive_peak_distance_mb,
    additive_n_peaks
  )],
  by = "Transcript_cluster",
  all.x = TRUE
)

ase_rows[, additive_peak_marker_bp := as.numeric(sub("^[^_]+_", "", additive_peak_marker.id))]

# checks on whether grabbed marker is top LOD marker or near it
ase_rows[, marker_is_top_additive_peak := !is.na(additive_peak_marker.id) & marker == additive_peak_marker.id]
ase_rows[, marker_to_top_additive_peak_mb := abs(marker_bp - additive_peak_marker_bp) / 1e6]
ase_rows[, marker_near_top_additive_peak := !is.na(marker_to_top_additive_peak_mb) & marker_to_top_additive_peak_mb <= peak_window_mb]

# founder-side pairwise contrast
ase_rows[, predicted_coef_delta := coef_1 - coef_2]

# ASE-side pairwise contrast on an unbounded scale using ReadCount
ase_rows[, ase_log2_ratio := log2((ReadCount_1 + ase_ratio_pseudocount) / (ReadCount_2 + ase_ratio_pseudocount))]

# sign comparison
ase_rows[, ase_sign := sign(ase_log2_ratio)]
ase_rows[, coef_sign := sign(predicted_coef_delta)]
ase_rows[, sign_concordant := fifelse(
  is.na(ase_sign) | is.na(coef_sign),
  NA,
  ase_sign == coef_sign
)]

# clean output
ase_coef_comparison <- ase_rows[, .(
  Transcript_cluster,
  Sample,
  gene_id,
  chr,
  marker,
  marker_bp,
  fit_lod,
  nearest.marker.id,
  additive_peak_marker.id,
  additive_peak_marker_bp,
  additive_peak_lod,
  additive_peak_distance_mb,
  additive_n_peaks,
  marker_is_top_additive_peak,
  marker_to_top_additive_peak_mb,
  marker_near_top_additive_peak,
  Name_1,
  Name_2,
  founder_1_candidates_str,
  founder_2_candidates_str,
  parent1_founders,
  parent2_founders,
  valid_f1_pairs,
  hst_pair_valid,
  n_oriented_assignments,
  oriented_assignments,
  founder_1_code,
  founder_2_code,
  ReadCount_1,
  ReadCount_2,
  TPM_1,
  TPM_2,
  TPM_sum,
  TPM_diff_ratio,
  ase_log2_ratio,
  coef_1,
  coef_2,
  predicted_coef_delta,
  ase_sign,
  coef_sign,
  sign_concordant
)]

ase_coef_summary <- ase_coef_comparison[, .(
  n_rows = .N,
  n_with_both_coefs = sum(!is.na(coef_1) & !is.na(coef_2)),
  frac_with_both_coefs = sum(!is.na(coef_1) & !is.na(coef_2)) / .N,
  n_sign_concordant = sum(sign_concordant, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_sign_concordant = sum(sign_concordant, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(sign_concordant)),
  n_marker_is_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_is_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_marker_is_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_is_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE) / .N,
  n_marker_near_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_near_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_marker_near_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_near_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE) / .N
)]

ase_coef_summary
head(ase_coef_comparison)
```

```{r plot_comparison of ASE log2 ratio vs predicted coefficient delta, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# plot ASE log2 ratio vs predicted coefficient delta for rows with both coefficients available
ggplot(
  ase_coef_comparison[!is.na(coef_1) & !is.na(coef_2)],
  aes(x = predicted_coef_delta, y = ase_log2_ratio)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0, size = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Founder Coefficient\nDelta vs ASE log2 Ratio",
    x = "Predicted Founder Coefficient Delta\n(Founder 1 - Founder 2)",
    y = "ASE log2 Ratio\nlog2((ReadCount_1 + 0.5) / (ReadCount_2 + 0.5))"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_cowplot()
```

```{r}
# plot ase_sign vs coef_sign for rows with both signs available as a true heatmap
plot_dt <- as.data.table(
  ase_coef_comparison[!is.na(ase_sign) & !is.na(coef_sign)]
)[
  ,
  .N,
  by = .(coef_sign, ase_sign)
]

# include all sign combinations so empty cells are shown
all_signs <- c(-1, 0, 1)
plot_dt <- merge(
  CJ(coef_sign = all_signs, ase_sign = all_signs),
  plot_dt,
  by = c("coef_sign", "ase_sign"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

plot_dt[is.na(N), N := 0]

plot_dt[, coef_sign := factor(coef_sign, levels = c(-1, 0, 1))]
plot_dt[, ase_sign := factor(ase_sign, levels = c(-1, 0, 1))]

ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = coef_sign, y = ase_sign, fill = N)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = N), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Sign Concordance Between ASE and Predicted Coefficients",
    x = "Predicted Coefficient Sign",
    y = "ASE log2 Ratio Sign",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot()
```

```{r}
transcript_coef_summary <- ase_coef_comparison[, .(
  n_samples = .N,

), by = Transcript_cluster]

transcript_coef_summary[, .(

  n_marker_is_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_is_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_marker_is_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_is_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE) / .N,
  n_marker_near_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_near_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_marker_near_top_additive_peak = sum(marker_near_top_additive_peak, na.rm = TRUE) / .N
)]
```
